observe.intro: Tongue and pulse are self-observed and count for less in the calculation; the constitution questionnaire looks at your long-standing tendencies. Skip any of them if you like — nothing else depends on them.
observe.pulse.measure.title: Measure
observe.pulse.optional: Optional. Fill it in only if you can tell; if you are not sure, leave it empty — and do not worry if you cannot feel it.
observe.pulse.qualities.hint: Only one in each group; we say why when one replaces another.
observe.pulse.qualities.title: If you can tell (advanced)
observe.pulse.rate.hint: Measure after sitting quietly for a few minutes. You can use the 30-second timer below: count the beats in 30 seconds and double them.
observe.pulse.rate.invalid: Enter a whole number from 20 to 250.
observe.pulse.rate.label: Resting pulse (beats per minute)
observe.pulse.timer.done: Time is up. Enter the number of beats you counted.
observe.pulse.title: Pulse
observe.title: Optional: observation, pulse and constitution
observe.tongue.body.title: Body colour
observe.tongue.coat.hint: Choose the closest one; a dry coating can be ticked as well.
observe.tongue.coat.title: Coating (overall)
observe.tongue.how.body: Best in the morning, before eating, drinking or brushing, in natural light, with the tongue relaxed and not pushed out hard. Avoid foods that stain (coffee, tea, coloured sweets) just before.
observe.tongue.how.quality: Self-observation is less reliable, so it counts for less in the calculation.
observe.tongue.how.title: How to look
observe.tongue.shape.title: Shape
observe.tongue.sheet.empty: Nothing can be chosen for this zone.
observe.tongue.sublingual: Underside: curl the tip up to the roof of the mouth and look at the two veins under the tongue — their thickness and colour.
observe.tongue.title: Tongue
observe.tongue.zones.hint: Tap a zone on the figure to see only what can appear there; the checklist below is the same data as the figure.
observe.tongue.zones.map: Tongue zone map; the zones can be selected
observe.tongue.zones.title: Zones and special signs
